module_summary: Simple dual-port RAM: a register array written on write_en at write_addr, with a registered read port that outputs zero when read_en is low.

anchors.name: RAM
anchors.why: Memory array written by write port and read into read_data

anchors.name: read_data
anchors.why: Registered read output from RAM, cleared when read_en low

anchors.name: write_data
anchors.why: Write payload stored into RAM at write_addr

anchors.name: read_en
anchors.why: Enables loading read_data from RAM, else zero

anchors.name: read_addr
anchors.why: Selects RAM location read into read_data

groups.name: Memory array
groups.description: Register-array RAM storage cleared on reset

groups.name: Write port
groups.description: Writes write_data to RAM[write_addr] when write_en

groups.name: Read port
groups.description: Registers RAM[read_addr] into read_data when read_en
